text: Gunfire, a DC Comics superhero and freelance anti-terrorist operative created by Len Wein and Steve Erwin, first appeared in Deathstroke Annual #2 (October 1993) and is one of the "New Bloods," a group of superpowered individuals introduced during the 1993 DC Comics Bloodlines crossover event. Andrew Van Horn is the son of an unnamed business executive who inherits the family business after his father's death. During the Bloodlines crossover, he is attacked by the alien parasite Venev and gains the ability to manipulate kinetic energy. In Infinite Crisis, he fights the Secret Society of Super Villains during their assault on Metropolis, where Prometheus amputates his hands. In Final Crisis, Superman rescues Gunfire along with others from Limbo, a dimension containing forgotten characters. In Heroes in Crisis, Gunfire is one of the patients at the Sanctuary therapy center who is killed in an unexpected attack. Gunfire can charge any object by touching it, causing it to emit energy and function like a gun before disintegrating.
